description: This file defines a Python class 'Code128' for generating Code 128 barcodes, including encoding, validation, and decomposition methods. It references external modules and contains barcode pattern data.

classes.name: Code128
classes.description: A class for creating and encoding Code 128 barcodes, supporting various options such as size, quiet zones, and encoding modes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Code128 barcode object with specified value and options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value for encoding, ensuring it contains only valid characters.

methods.name: _trailingDigitsToC
methods.description: Optimizes encoding by converting trailing digit sequences to Code C for double density.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the input value into a sequence of barcode patterns.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Converts the encoded barcode into a human-readable pattern string.
